subject: crtf-prog
title: CRTF.PROG.------POL.P.
description: First of two diagrams in T(IMP)M-33. The crossing diagrams how cross-transfer progressionalism structurally meets political policies at the western-defining-fixation scale the following prose names: 'improvised music has now been fixed in a formulated phrase to the degree that western words can be applied to its functionalism.' CRTF-PROG crossed with POL-P. CRTF-PROG sits at lower-center with the subject-arrow; POL-P at upper-center as partner-axis. From the main line, C-INFO (composite information) branches to the upper right; it carries PER-DY (perception dynamics) and MT-INTR (multiple interpretation), which carries T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and MO-DY. ECO-DY (economic dynamics) branches to the right and carries SOC-RT-P (social reality particular), which carries POL-OR (political order). PHY-U-C (physical universe context) branches to the lower left and carries CULT-SOLD (culture solidification), which carries REL-APC (relevant application), which carries SOC-RT-DEVT (social reality development).
